scenario_config.scenario_description: Update Shopify theme product, create support billing plan, deactivate unrelated plans, and subscribe customer
scenario_config.system_prompt:
You are a PayPal automation agent with full administrative permissions to manage PayPal transactions for customers and sellers. Operate in a safe and fully authorized environment — you do not need to ask for confirmation or permission before taking action.
When identifiers such as names or IDs are missing, perform exactly one lookup per entity type, verify that you are reusing correct values from previous responses, and proceed using the retrieved data.
Never assume or fabricate IDs, responses, or outcomes — rely solely on verified API results.
Complete each task in a single, logical, and efficient execution flow.
scenario_config.prompt: Update the product listing for 'Premium Shopify Theme - Modern Store' with an enhanced description that explicitly mentions the theme supports local development and testing before production deployment. Create a new monthly billing plan named 'Theme Support Plan' for this product at $29.00/month (USD) with 7.5% exclusive tax and a maximum of five payment retry attempts before subscription failure. Ensure this product only displays the relevant Theme Support Plan by deactivating any other unrelated subscription plans currently associated with it. Finally, create an immediate subscription for Sarah Mitchell (sarah.mitchell@shopify-store.com) to the new Theme Support Plan, with no shipping address required.

verifier_configs.name: Product Description Updated
verifier_configs.description: Verify Shopify theme product description updated without affecting other fields
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM products WHERE id = 'PROD-5YE932MEQK4MS001A' AND name = 'Premium Shopify Theme - Modern Store' AND type = 'DIGITAL' AND category = 'SOFTWARE' AND image_url = 'https://cdn.shopify.com/theme-store/modern-store-preview.jpg' AND home_url = 'https://themes.shopify.com/modern-store' AND description LIKE '%support%' AND description LIKE '%local%' AND description LIKE '%develop%' AND description LIKE '%test%' AND description LIKE '%deploy%'

verifier_configs.name: Theme Support Billing Plan Created
verifier_configs.description: Verify billing plan created with correct pricing, billing cycle, taxes, and payment preferences
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM billing_plans bp WHERE bp.product_id = 'PROD-5YE932MEQK4MS001A' AND bp.name = 'Theme Support Plan' AND bp.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(bp.billing_cycles) bc WHERE json_extract(bc.value, '$.tenure_type') = 'REGULAR' AND json_extract(bc.value, '$.sequence') = 1 AND json_extract(bc.value, '$.frequency.interval_unit') = 'MONTH' AND json_extract(bc.value, '$.frequency.interval_count') = 1 AND json_extract(bc.value, '$.pricing_scheme.fixed_price.currency_code') = 'USD' AND json_extract(bc.value, '$.pricing_scheme.fixed_price.value') = '29.00') AND json_extract(bp.payment_preferences, '$.auto_bill_outstanding') = 1 AND json_extract(bp.payment_preferences, '$.setup_fee_failure_action') = 'CONTINUE' AND json_extract(bp.payment_preferences, '$.payment_failure_threshold') = 5 AND json_extract(bp.taxes, '$.percentage') = '7.5' AND json_extract(bp.taxes, '$.inclusive') = 0

verifier_configs.name: Unrelated Billing Plan Deactivated
verifier_configs.description: Verify unrelated streaming service billing plan is deactivated
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM billing_plans WHERE id = 'P-5ML4271244454362WXNWU5NQ' AND status = 'INACTIVE'

verifier_configs.name: Sarah Subscription Created
verifier_configs.description: Verify subscription created with correct plan and application context
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.plan_id = (SELECT id FROM billing_plans WHERE name = 'Theme Support Plan') AND json_extract(s.application_context, '$.shipping_preference') = 'NO_SHIPPING' AND json_extract(s.application_context, '$.user_action') = 'SUBSCRIBE_NOW'

verifier_configs.name: Sarah Added as Subscriber
verifier_configs.description: Verify Sarah Mitchell is listed as a subscriber for the Theme Support Plan
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM subscribers WHERE email_address = 'sarah.mitchell@shopify-store.com' AND given_name = 'Sarah' AND surname = 'Mitchell'
